description: A clinical research medical director must decide whether to authorize tomorrow's investigational infusion for a hospital trial participant and finalize the monitoring, consent, pharmacy, and transportation plan, with input from research pharmacy, laboratory coordination, regulatory compliance, and social work.

shared_context.S1: A trial participant is scheduled for an investigational infusion tomorrow at the hospital research unit.
shared_context.S2: The research unit has not yet authorized the dose or finalized the participant's monitoring and discharge arrangements.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan signs off on the infusion authorization and the accompanying care plan.
shared_context.S4: The research unit's standard pre-dose huddle is held before each infusion authorization, with research pharmacy, laboratory coordination, compliance, and social work reporting their operational findings.

PF1.text: The investigational product batch can be released for this participant only on Friday at 10:00 AM; the pharmacy has reserved that release time, and no dose can be prepared for tomorrow's scheduled infusion.

PF2.text: The participant's pre-dose ANC is 1.3 x10^9/L, below the protocol threshold of 1.5 x10^9/L, so tomorrow's dose must be held and the ANC must be repeated Friday at 08:00 before any later dose is considered.

PF3.text: The participant's signed consent is for an expired protocol version, so the participant must complete the current consent form before receiving the next investigational dose.

PF4.text: The participant's caregiver can provide supervision only from Friday 10:00 through 14:00; wheelchair transportation is already booked for pickup at 09:15 and return at 15:00 on Friday.

acceptance_conditions: Tomorrow's investigational infusion must not be authorized because the participant's ANC is below the protocol threshold.
The recorded ANC must be exactly 1.3 x10^9/L and a repeat ANC must be scheduled for Friday at 08:00.
The investigational infusion must be rescheduled for Friday at 10:00, when the pharmacy can release the batch.
The participant must complete the current consent form before receiving the rescheduled dose.
The monitoring and caregiver observation window must be Friday from 10:00 through 14:00.
The booked wheelchair transportation must be documented with pickup at 09:15 and return at 15:00.
The low ANC finding must be cited as justification for withholding tomorrow's dose.

content_checks.C7: decisions['transport_plan'] == 'wheelchair pickup Friday 09:15 and return Friday 15:00'
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'repeat_anc' and c['target'] == 'Research Laboratory' and c['detail'] == 'Friday 08:00' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The pharmacy reservation changes the rescheduled infusion time from an unspecified future appointment to exactly Friday at 10:00.
The exact ANC of 1.3 changes the dose authorization to false, records 1.3, and requires a repeat ANC commitment exactly at Friday 08:00.
The expired consent version changes the consent field from routine consent to the exact requirement for current consent before the next dose.
The caregiver's four-hour availability and booked transport change the plan to the exact Friday 10:00-14:00 observation window and the exact 09:15 pickup and 15:00 return.
